gloss: green bean; string bean; snap bean

definitions.gloss: green bean; string bean; snap bean
definitions.explanation: the immature pod of the common bean plant, eaten whole as a vegetable

examples.japanese: さやいんげんの{胡麻|ごま}{和|あ}えを{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To make green beans with sesame dressing.

examples.japanese: さやいんげんは{茹|ゆ}ですぎると{色|いろ}が{悪|わる}くなる。
examples.english: If you overboil green beans, they lose their color.

examples.japanese: さやいんげんは{夏|なつ}が{旬|しゅん}で、{天|てん}ぷらや{煮物|にもの}、{炒|いた}め{物|もの}など{様々|さまざま}な{料理|りょうり}に{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: Green beans are in season in summer and are used in various dishes such as tempura, simmered dishes, and stir-fries.

notes:
A common vegetable in Japanese cooking, eaten as the whole immature pod. The name comes from {莢|さや} (pod) + いんげん (from {隠元|いんげん}, the Zen monk Ingen who is said to have brought the bean to Japan in the 17th century). Also written as さや{隠元|いんげん} or {莢隠元|さやいんげん}.

COMMON DISHES:
- さやいんげんの{胡麻|ごま}{和|あ}え — green beans with sesame dressing
- さやいんげんの{天|てん}ぷら — green bean tempura
- さやいんげんの{煮物|にもの} — simmered green beans
- さやいんげんの{炒|いた}め{物|もの} — stir-fried green beans
- さやいんげんの{肉|にく}{巻|ま}き — meat-wrapped green beans

COOKING TIPS:
- Briefly blanched to retain bright color and crisp texture
- Often used as a colorful garnish alongside {人参|にんじん} (carrot) in {弁当|べんとう}

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いんげん{豆|まめ} — kidney bean, common bean (the mature dried bean)
- {枝豆|えだまめ} — edamame (immature soybeans, a different plant)
- さやえんどう — snow pea (flatter, different species)
